dedupe_keys.name: province of novara road code violation series

description: The Province of Novara publishes fifteen year-labelled road-code violation listings. The native field schema names year, violation type, legal rule/article, date, vehicle type, province, municipality, street/address/postcode and sanction count. This describes vehicle-related enforcement records. Counts of sanctions do not measure traffic volumes, trips or road capacity. Actual violations, locations and dates were not read. Coverage follows the named publisher Provincia di Novara, Italy; geographic and time-series completeness remain unverified. The declared licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a fixed version. CSV distributions are listed. Metadata access was verified, but later file-use charges and populated fields remain unknown. No specific simulation application is documented. These 15 year-labelled listings form one source series. Period labels are not a claim of continuous coverage, and possible overlapping observations are not counted as independent events. File-use costs remain unknown. Related models and simulation software are not identified by the source.
